ignoreType.description:
If true, ignore type metadata for built instances. This will essentially display the JSON serialized version of
the objects instead of the marked-up structure.

initialExpand.description:
How much of the tree to initially expand:
 - `none` fully collapsed
 - `root` only top-level object/collection expanded
 - `all` entire tree fully expanded

showEmptyCollections.description:
Normally, empty collections are ignored, but if this flag is set, they will be shown as `[]` or `{}` in the
tree (but will not be expandable).

showAllFields.description:
Normally, null/undefined values are ignored, but if this flag is set, they will be shown as `null` or `undefined`
in the tree when rendering an Obj instance. Note that this implicitly includes #showEmptyCollections, since _all_
fields are shown (whether set or not) and unset collection fields will be empty arrays/objects.

maxArraySize.description:
Maximum number of array elements to expand at once. This helps avoid excessively long display times or crashing
the browser tab when very large arrays are expanded.

title: This component display arbitrary data, such as a Obj instance and children or even any JSON object.
name: DataTree
